full_judgment: 4. After obtaining the absolute ownership and possession of the case property, the same was recorded in the S.A. Khatian No.382 in the name of the petitioner. Subsequently, the property was recorded in the name of the petitioner in R.S. Khatian No.924. In the latest City Survey, the property was recorded in the name of the petitioner, vide City Jorip Khatian No.1584. In the month of March, 2001 the petitioner collected the City Jorip Khatian and came to know that the property has been included in the list of abandoned property. Upon query he found that the case property has been enlisted in the `ka' list of the Abandoned Buildings published in the official gazette dated 23.09.1986 at page 9762(8), Serial No.34.
